#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    regex r("(.)\\1*");
    smatch m;
    int count = 0;
    string::const_iterator searchStart(s.cbegin());
    while (regex_search(searchStart, s.cend(), m, r)) {
        if ((m.length() & 1) == 0) {
            count++;
        }
        searchStart = m.suffix().first;
    }
    cout << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
